ui.lib.game.sudokuConflict: Wonke amabhokisi agcwele kodwa ezinye izinombolo ziyaphindaphindeka. Sicela uhlole futhi.
ui.lib.game.chessNote: Udlala ngoMhlophe futhi uqala. Chofoza ucezu lwakho, bese uchofoza isikwele ofuna ukuya kuso. Ipawn efinyelela umugqa wokugcina iba yindlovukazi. Nqoba ngokubeka uMnyama kushaki mate.
ui.lib.game.xqNote: Udlala ngoBomvu (ngezansi) futhi uqala. Chofoza ucezu lwakho, bese uchofoza iphoyinti ofuna ukuya kulo. Amajenerali amabili akavunyelwe ukubhekana; shaki mate noma ukungabi namathuba avumelekile kuyahlulwa.
ui.lib.game.goNote: Ibhodi le-{n}×{n}. Udlala ngoMnyama futhi uqala. Amaphuzu abalwa ngendawo (amatshe + amaphoyinti angenalutho azungezwe ngokuphelele); uMhlophe uthola i-komi engu-{k}. Thumba wonke amatshe afile omphikisi ngaphambi kokudlulisa. Ukuzibulala nokubuyisa ngokushesha (ko) akuvunyelwe. Umdlalo uphela lapho abadlali bobabili bedlulisa ngokulandelana.

home.title: WFTools — Amathuluzi amahhala aku-inthanethi
home.metaDescription: Amathuluzi amahhala aku-inthanethi: umenzi wekhodi ye-QR ne-barcode, ukucindezela nokuguqula izithombe, ukuhlanganisa/ukuhlukanisa i-PDF, isiguquli se-JSON/XML/CSV/Excel, iholo, imali ebolekiwe, i-BMI, ithayimthebula, ukubala okwehlayo nokunye. Kusebenza kusiphequluli ngaphandle kokubhalisa.
home.lead: Khetha ithuluzi ulisebenzise ngqo kusiphequluli sakho. Akudingeki ukubhalisa, futhi idatha yakho ayiphumi neze kudivayisi yakho.
home.keywords: amathuluzi aku-inthanethi, amathuluzi amahhala, umenzi wekhodi ye-QR, umenzi we-barcode, isicindezeli sezithombe, amathuluzi e-PDF, isiguquli samafayela, isibali seholo, i-BMI, amathuluzi ewebhu

file.desc: Hlanganisa noma hlukanisa i-PDF, guqula i-PowerPoint, qhathanisa imibhalo futhi uguqule idatha.

business.desc: Amathuluzi ezitolo zaku-inthanethi, amabhizinisi amancane nabasebenza ngokuzimela.

marketing.name: Ukumaketha
marketing.desc: Amakhodi e-QR, izixhumanisi zomkhankaso nemibala yohlobo.

health.name: Impilo
health.desc: Landelela isisindo, ukudla, amanzi, umsebenzi nomjikelezo.

edu.name: Imfundo nokufundisa
edu.desc: Amathayimthebula, ama-quiz, ukuba khona, amabalazwe engqondo nokukhokhelwa.

time.name: Amathuluzi esikhathi
time.desc: Amawashi, ukubala okwehlayo, izindawo zesikhathi, izinsuku zomsebenzi nedayari.

dev.name: Amathuluzi onjiniyela
dev.desc: Fometha, hlola, bethela futhi uguqule ikhodi yomthombo.

text.name: Amathuluzi ombhalo
text.desc: Izinhlamvu ezinkulu/ezincane, amafonti amahle ezinkundla zokuxhumana, umbhalo uye enkulumweni nokuthayipha ngezwi.

device.name: Ukuhlolwa kwedivayisi
device.desc: Hlola i-webcam, qopha isikrini, kala isivinini sokuthayipha nokuchofoza ngomzuzwana.

media.name: Umsindo nevidiyo
media.desc: Cindezela ividiyo, khipha umsindo we-MP3 futhi ushune isiginci kusiphequluli.

excel.name: Ukuphatha idatha ye-Excel
excel.desc: Gcwalisa i-Word ku-Excel, hlanganisa amaseli, beka imigqa ngokuqondile futhi uhlanganise amashithi amaningi noma amafayela e-Excel ngamafomula.

entertainment.name: Zokuzijabulisa nemidlalo
entertainment.desc: Isondo lenhlanhla, isenzi samanani angahleliwe, imidlalo yokudwebela imikhonzo nemidlalo ethokozisayo.

image-convert.name: Cindezela izithombe
image-convert.desc: Nciphisa amafayela ezithombe futhi ucindezele izithombe eziningi kanyekanye ukuze zilayishe ngokushesha futhi zithunyelwe nge-imeyili.

image-format.name: Guqula ifomethi yesithombe
image-format.desc: Guqula izithombe phakathi kwe-JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP ne-ICO (i-favicon) zamawebhusayithi, ama-app noma ukugcina.

image-base64.name: Isithombe → Base64
image-base64.desc: Guqula izithombe zibe yimigqa ye-Base64 ukuze uzifake ku-HTML, CSS noma ikhodi, bese ubuyisela i-Base64 ibe yisithombe.

bg-remove.name: Susa ingemuva lesithombe
bg-remove.desc: Susa ingemuva elimhlophe noma lombala owodwa ezithombeni zemikhiqizo, amalogo nama-avatar khona manjalo kudivayisi yakho.

watermark.name: Engeza uphawu lwamanzi ezithombeni
watermark.desc: Engeza umbhalo, ilogo noma uphawu lwelungelo lokushicilela esithombeni esisodwa noma eziningi kanyekanye.

pdf-merge.name: Hlanganisa uhlukanise i-PDF
pdf-merge.desc: Hlanganisa amafayela amaningi e-PDF abe linye, khipha amakhasi owadingayo noma uhlukanise i-PDF ikhasi ngekhasi.

pptx-pdf.name: PowerPoint ↔ PDF
pptx-pdf.desc: Guqula amaslayidi e-PowerPoint (.pptx) abe yi-PDF namafayela e-PDF abe yi-PowerPoint.

file-diff.name: Qhathanisa amafayela amabili
file-diff.desc: Thola umehluko phakathi kwemibhalo emibili: TXT, Word, HTML noma i-PDF enombhalo. Izingxenye ezengeziwe, ezisusiwe nezishintshiwe ziyagqanyiswa.

text-analysis.name: Ukuhlaziywa kombhalo
text-analysis.desc: Bala amagama, izinhlamvu, imisho nezigaba zombhalo, TXT, Word noma PDF, ulinganise isikhathi sokufunda nobuningi bamagama angukhiye.

data-convert.name: Guqula i-JSON, XML, CSV, Excel
data-convert.desc: Guqula idatha phakathi kwe-JSON, XML, CSV ne-Excel (.xlsx) ngokubuka ithebula kuqala.

bmi-bmr.name: Isibali se-BMI ne-BMR
bmi-bmr.desc: Bala inkomba yesisindo somzimba (BMI), isilinganiso sokhalo nezinqulu kanye nezidingo zama-khalori (BMR, TDEE) ngokobudala, ubulili nezinga lomsebenzi.

meal-calo.name: Umhleli wokudla kwansuku zonke nama-khalori
meal-calo.desc: Hlela ukudla ngokomgomo wama-khalori, thola ama-khalori okudla okuvamile, ulinganise amaprotheni, ama-carbohydrate namafutha.

water-tracker.name: Umlandeli wokuphuza amanzi
water-tracker.desc: Beka umgomo wansuku zonke futhi ubhale ukuthi uphuze amanzi angakanani ngomlando wezinsuku ezimbalwa nemiphumela.

calo-burn.name: Ama-khalori ashiswe ngomsebenzi
calo-burn.desc: Linganisa ama-khalori ashisiwe ngokwezemidlalo, umsebenzi, isikhathi nesisindo somzimba usebenzisa amanani e-MET.

cycle-track.name: Umlandeli womjikelezo wokuya esikhathini
cycle-track.desc: Bhala futhi ubikezele umjikelezo wokuya esikhathini, usuku lokukhishwa kweqanda nezinsuku ezinamathuba aphezulu okukhulelwa. Idatha ihlala kudivayisi yakho kuphela.

study-timetable.name: Ithayimthebula yesikole
study-timetable.desc: Yenza ithayimthebula yamasonto ngezifundo; yiphrinte noma uyigcine ukuze uyisebenzise nsuku zonke.

quiz-bank.name: I-quiz nebhange lemibuzo
quiz-bank.desc: Yakha ibhange lemibuzo yokukhetha okuningi, xuba imibuzo, wenze isivivinyo esinamaphuzu futhi uphrinte uviwo nezimpendulo.

attendance.name: Ukuba khona
attendance.desc: Yenza uhlu lwekilasi, umake ukuba khona esifundweni ngasinye, ulandelele ukungabikho nokufika sekwephuzile. Kungavumelaniswa ne-Google Sheets.

mindmap.name: Ibalazwe lengqondo nesifinyezo
mindmap.desc: Dweba amabalazwe engqondo ezifundo futhi ufinyeze umbhalo omude ube amaphuzu amakhulu ngokuzenzakalelayo.

teaching-pay.name: Amahora okufundisa nokukhokhelwa
teaching-pay.desc: Bhala izifundo ozifundisile, ubale inkokhelo ngokwamahora nenani, ukhiphe umbiko.

fullscreen-clock.name: Iwashi lesikrini esigcwele
fullscreen-clock.desc: Iwashi elikhulu ledijithali lesikrini esigcwele elinesitopuwashi nokubala okwehlayo; imibala, ifonti nefomethi yamahora angu-12/24 kuyashintsheka.

countdown-video.name: Umenzi wevidiyo yokubala okwehlayo
countdown-video.desc: Dala isibali sakho sokwehlayo bese usilanda njengevidiyo ukuze usisebenzise ekuhleleni.

world-clock.name: Iwashi lomhlaba
world-clock.desc: Bona isikhathi samanje emazweni amaningana kanyekanye futhi uqhathanise umehluko wezindawo zesikhathi.

workdays.name: Isibali sezinsuku zomsebenzi
workdays.desc: Bala izinsuku zomsebenzi phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili ngaphandle kwangeMgqibelo, iSonto namaholidi.

journal.name: Idayari yaku-inthanethi
journal.desc: Bhala idayari egcinwa ngasese ku-Google Sheet yakho ongayifunda wena kuphela.

code-format.name: Ukufometha i-JS, HTML, CSS, JSON
code-format.desc: Fometha kahle futhi uhlele ikhodi ye-JavaScript, HTML, CSS ne-JSON.

code-check.name: Isihloli sesakhiwo
code-check.desc: Thola amaphutha esakhiwo ku-JavaScript, HTML, CSS ne-JSON ngomugqa nekholomu.

js-obfuscate.name: Isifihli se-JavaScript
js-obfuscate.desc: Faka ikhodi emigqeni, qamba kabusha okuguquguqukayo futhi ufihle i-JavaScript ukuze kube nzima ukuyifunda nokuyikopisha.

rsa-keys.name: Okhiye be-RSA nokubethela
rsa-keys.desc: Dala ipheya yokhiye be-RSA (PEM), bethela umbhalo ngokhiye womphakathi futhi uwuvule ngokhiye oyimfihlo, konke kudivayisi yakho.

text-to-html.name: Umbhalo ofomethiwe → HTML
text-to-html.desc: Hlela ngokubonakalayo ngokugqamile, izihloko, uhlu, amathebula nezixhumanisi, bese uthola ikhodi ye-HTML ehlanzekile.

inventory.name: Isitoko namanani
inventory.desc: Beka amanani okuthengisa ngokwekhomishini yemakethe, ukukhangisa nenzuzo. Landelela isitoko esingenayo nesiphumayo ngezexwayiso zesitoko esiphansi.

invoice.name: I-invoyisi nesilinganiso
invoice.desc: Dala izilinganiso nama-invoyisi okuthengisa ngelogo, izamba ezizenzakalelayo nenani elibhalwe ngamagama. Phrinta noma ugcine njenge-PDF.

menu-qr.name: Imenyu ye-QR
menu-qr.desc: Dala imenyu yedijithali yezindawo zokudlela namakhefi. Izivakashi ziskena ikhodi ye-QR ukuze zibone ukudla namanani.

barcode.name: Umenzi we-barcode
barcode.desc: Dala ama-barcode e-Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A ne-Code 39 yamalebula emikhiqizo nesitoko.

loan.name: Isibali semali ebolekiwe
loan.desc: Inkokhelo yanyanga zonke, inzalo ephelele nohlelo lokukhokha lwemali mboleko yendlu, yemoto neyomuntu siqu.

compound.name: Inzalo ehlanganisiwe nokonga
compound.desc: Bala ukuthi uzoqongelela malini ngokonga noma ngokutshala imali njalo ngenyanga.

salary.name: Iholo i-gross ↔ net
salary.desc: Guqula iholo eliphelele libe iholo elifika esandleni nokuphambene ngokwemithetho ka-2026 yomshwalense nentela yemali engenayo yomuntu siqu (eVietnam).

qr-code.name: Umenzi wekhodi ye-QR
qr-code.desc: Dala amakhodi e-QR ezixhumanisi, umbhalo, i-Wi‑Fi, i-imeyili nezinombolo zocingo. Landa njenge-PNG noma i-SVG.

utm.name: Umakhi wesixhumanisi se-UTM
utm.desc: Engeza amakhodi okulandelela umkhankaso ezixhumanisini ukuze ubone ukuthi izivakashi zivela kuphi isiteshi.

colors.name: Iphalethi yemibala namakhodi
colors.desc: Yakha iphalethi evumelanayo kusukela kumbala oyisisekelo bese uthola amakhodi e-HEX, RGB, HSL nokuguquguquka kwe-CSS.

expense.name: Izindleko nebhajethi
expense.desc: Bhala imali engenayo nezindleko zansuku zonke, ubone izindleko ngezigaba futhi ubeke umkhawulo ukuze uhlale ngaphakathi kwebhajethi.

habit.name: Umlandeli wemikhuba nochungechunge
habit.desc: Maka imikhuba nsuku zonke futhi ulandelele uchungechunge lwezinsuku ezilandelanayo ukuze uhlale uqinile.

cv.name: Umakhi we-CV
cv.desc: Gcwalisa isifanekiso ngokubuka bukhoma, khetha isakhiwo nombala, uphrinte mahhala noma ugcine njenge-PDF.

currency-time.name: Izimali nezindawo zesikhathi
currency-time.desc: Guqula izimali ngezilinganiso zakamuva futhi uhlole isikhathi emadolobheni omhlaba.

image-resize.name: Shintsha usayizi wesithombe
image-resize.desc: Shintsha usayizi wezithombe ngamaphikseli noma ngamaphesenti, ugcine isilinganiso futhi ucubungule izithombe eziningi kanyekanye.

image-crop.name: Sika isithombe
image-crop.desc: Sika izithombe ngokukhululekile noma ngezilinganiso 1:1, 4:3, 16:9 no-9:16, uphendule noma uphenye ngaphambi kokulanda.

image-ocr.name: Umbhalo osuka esithombeni (OCR)
image-ocr.desc: Khipha umbhalo ezithombeni, kuzithombe-skrini nasemadokhumentini askeniwe. Isekela isiZulu, isiNgisi nezinye izilimi ezingaphezu kuka-30.

heic-jpg.name: HEIC → JPG
heic-jpg.desc: Guqula izithombe ze-HEIC ze-iPhone zibe yi-JPG noma i-PNG ezivuleka yonke indawo. Isekela ukuguqula ngamaqoqo.

image-upscale.name: Khulisa isithombe nge-AI
image-upscale.desc: Khulisa izithombe ngo-2× noma ngo-4× futhi ucacise imininingwane nge-AI. Kuhle kakhulu ezithombeni ezincane, ezifiphele noma ezindala.

image-to-pdf.name: Isithombe → PDF
image-to-pdf.desc: Hlanganisa izithombe ze-JPG ne-PNG zibe yi-PDF eyodwa, uhlele kabusha amakhasi, ukhethe usayizi wephepha nemiphetho.

pdf-to-image.name: PDF → isithombe
pdf-to-image.desc: Guqula ikhasi ngalinye le-PDF libe yi-JPG noma i-PNG ecacile, ukhethe ukucaca, ulande izithombe ezihlukene noma i-ZIP.

pdf-compress.name: Cindezela i-PDF
pdf-compress.desc: Nciphisa amafayela e-PDF e-imeyili namafomu aku-inthanethi. Khetha izinga lokucindezela bese uqhathanisa osayizi.

pdf-to-word.name: PDF → Word
pdf-to-word.desc: Guqula i-PDF ibe yifayela le-Word (.docx) elihlelekayo eligcina umbhalo nezigaba, noma ugcine isakhiwo sekhasi njengezithombe.

word-to-pdf.name: Word → PDF
word-to-pdf.desc: Guqula amafayela e-Word (.docx) abe yi-PDF kusiphequluli, uqale ubuke, bese ulanda noma uphrinte.

pdf-sign.name: Sayina i-PDF
pdf-sign.desc: Dweba noma uthayiphe isiginesha yakho, wengeze isiginesha yesithombe nosuku, uyibeke emakhasini e-PDF bese uyalanda.

pdf-edit.name: Hlela i-PDF futhi ugcwalise amafomu
pdf-edit.desc: Engeza umbhalo, amamaki namabhokisi okumboza ku-PDF futhi ugcwalise izinkambu zefomu ezikhona.

case-convert.name: Isiguquli sezinhlamvu ezinkulu/ezincane
case-convert.desc: Guqula umbhalo ube IZINHLAMVU EZINKULU, izinhlamvu ezincane, Isimo Sesihloko, Isimo somusho, camelCase, snake_case nokunye.

fancy-text.name: Umenzi wombhalo omuhle
fancy-text.desc: Guqula umbhalo ojwayelekile ube amafonti anesitayela angaphezu kuka-30 e-bio ye-Instagram, TikTok, Facebook namagama emidlalo. Kopisha ngokuchofoza okukodwa.

text-to-speech.name: Umbhalo uye enkulumweni
text-to-speech.desc: Funda umbhalo ngokuzwakalayo ngamazwi edivayisi yakho. Khetha izwi, isivinini nephimbo. Isekela izilimi eziningi.

speech-to-text.name: Inkulumo iye embhalweni
speech-to-text.desc: Thayipha ngezwi lakho: khuluma kumakrofoni, umbhalo uvela khona manjalo, bese uwukopisha noma uwulande.

scientific-calc.name: Isibali sesayensi
scientific-calc.desc: Isibali saku-inthanethi esine-trigonometry, ama-logarithm, amandla, izimpande, i-factorial, ama-degree/radian, inkumbulo nomlando.

percentage.name: Isibali samaphesenti
percentage.desc: Thola u-X% ka-Y, ukuthi u-X uyiphesenti elingakanani lika-Y, ushintsho lwephesenti nentengo eyehlisiwe ngamafomula isinyathelo ngesinyathelo.

unit-convert.name: Isiguquli samayunithi
unit-convert.desc: Guqula ubude, isisindo, izinga lokushisa, indawo, ivolumu, isivinini, isikhathi, idatha, ingcindezi namandla.

age-calc.name: Isibali seminyaka
age-calc.desc: Bala iminyaka eqondile ngeminyaka, izinyanga nezinsuku, zonke izinsuku ophile zona, usuku lokuzalwa olulandelayo nophawu lwezinkanyezi.

date-calc.name: Isibali sezinsuku
date-calc.desc: Bala izinsuku phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili, wengeze noma ususe izinsuku, amasonto, izinyanga neminyaka, uthole usuku lwesonto.

gpa.name: Isibali se-GPA
gpa.desc: Bala i-GPA yesemester neyisamba esikalini esingu-4.0 ngamamaki ezinhlamvu ngokwamakhredithi.

due-date.name: Isibali sosuku lokubeletha
due-date.desc: Linganisa usuku lokubeletha nesonto lokukhulelwa ngokwesikhathi sokugcina, usuku lokukhulelwa noma i-ultrasound nezigaba eziyinhloko.

spin-wheel.name: Isondo lenhlanhla
spin-wheel.desc: Dala isondo elinanoma yimaphi amagama noma imiklomelo, lijikijele ngobulungiswa nangokungahleliwe, ususe abaphumelele, imodi yesikrini esigcwele.

random-number.name: Umenzi wezinombolo ezingahleliwe
random-number.desc: Dala izinombolo ezingahleliwe kunoma yibuphi ububanzi, eziningana kanyekanye, eziphindaphindwayo noma ezingaphindwa, zokuvota nemidlalo.

typing-test.name: Ukuhlolwa kwesivinini sokuthayipha
typing-test.desc: Kala isivinini sakho sokuthayipha (WPM) nokunemba kusukela kumasekhondi angu-30 kuya kumaminithi angu-5.

cps-test.name: Ukuhlolwa kwe-CPS (isivinini sokuchofoza)
cps-test.desc: Bala ukuchofoza ngesekhondi kusukela ku-1 kuya kumasekhondi angu-60, ugcine umphumela ohamba phambili, futhi uhlole ibha yesikhala nokuthinta.

webcam-test.name: Ukuhlolwa kwe-webcam
webcam-test.desc: Hlola ukuthi ikhamera iyasebenza, ubone ukucaca nesilinganiso sohlaka, ushintshe amakhamera futhi uthathe isithombe sokuhlola.

screen-recorder.name: Umqophi wesikrini
screen-recorder.desc: Qopha isikrini sakho, iwindi noma ithebhu ngomsindo wesistimu nemakrofoni, ngaphandle kokufaka lutho.

video-compress.name: Isicindezeli sevidiyo
video-compress.desc: Nciphisa amafayela e-MP4, MOV ne-WebM emilayezo, i-imeyili nezinkundla zokuxhumana. Khetha ukucaca nekhwalithi.

video-to-mp3.name: Ividiyo → MP3
video-to-mp3.desc: Khipha umsindo kumavidiyo e-MP4, MOV ne-WebM njenge-MP3, ukhethe ikhwalithi futhi usike ingxenye oyidingayo.

guitar-tuner.name: Ishuni lesiginci
guitar-tuner.desc: Shuna isiginci, i-ukulele ne-bass ngemakrofoni: inothi, ukuchezuka ngama-cent nenaliti, kanye nemisindo eyisibonelo.

password-gen.name: Umenzi wephasiwedi
password-gen.desc: Dala amaphasiwedi aqinile angahleliwe noma imisho yephasiwedi okulula ukuyikhumbula, ukhethe ubude nezimpawu, uhlole amandla.

signature.name: Umenzi wesiginesha
signature.desc: Dweba isiginesha yakho ngegundane noma ngomunwe, noma uyithayiphe ngefonti yokubhala ngesandla; landa i-PNG esobala.

logo-maker.name: Umenzi welogo
logo-maker.desc: Dala ilogo kusukela kusithonjana, igama lohlobo nesiqubulo; khetha ifonti, umbala nesakhiwo, ulande i-SVG noma i-PNG.

notepad.name: Incwadi yamanothi yaku-inthanethi
notepad.desc: Amanothi asheshayo agcinwa ngokuzenzakalelayo kusiphequluli: amanothi amaningi, ukusesha, inani lamagama nokulanda i-TXT.

excel-word-fill.name: Gcwalisa i-Word ku-Excel
excel-word-fill.desc: Thatha okuqukethwe kufayela le-Excel ukubeke ezimpawini zefayela le-Word, nezihloko ezinezinombolo ziboniswa ngokubomvu.

excel-cell-merge.name: Hlanganisa amaseli e-Excel emashitini / emafayeleni amaningi
excel-cell-merge.desc: Hlanganisa iseli elifanayo (A1, B2...) lamashithi noma amafayela e-Excel amaningi libe lilodwa, kunesexwayiso samaseli anedatha emthonjeni ongaphezu kowodwa.

excel-row-concat.name: Beka imigqa ye-Excel yamashithi / yamafayela amaningi
excel-row-concat.desc: Beka amashithi noma amafayela e-Excel amaningi ngokuqondile abe yithebula elilodwa elide. Gcina ikhanda kanye bese ususa imigqa engenalutho.

excel-formula-merge.name: Hlanganisa idatha ye-Excel ngamafomula
excel-formula-merge.desc: Hlanganisa amashithi noma amafayela e-Excel amaningi ngefomula ngeseli ngalinye (SUM, IF, CONCAT, UNIQUE...), imisebenzi efakwe phakathi komunye, namafomula agciniwe ongawasebenzisa futhi.

sudoku-9x9.name: Sudoku 9x9
sudoku-9x9.desc: Dlala i-Sudoku 9x9 ku-inthanethi ezingeni eli-10 kusuka kokulula kuya kokunzima, namanothi, izeluleko nokuhlola amaphutha.

sudoku-16x16.name: Sudoku 16x16
sudoku-16x16.desc: I-Sudoku enkulu engu-16x16 esebenzisa u-1-9 no-A-G, amazinga ayi-10 kusuka kokulula kuya kokunzima, namanothi nezeluleko.

chess.name: I-chess
chess.desc: Dlala i-chess nekhompyutha emazingeni angu-10 noma ku-inthanethi: mema umngane ngesixhumanisi noma udlale nomuntu omusha. Ine-castling, en passant nokukhushulwa.

xiangqi.name: I-Xiangqi (i-chess yaseShayina)
xiangqi.desc: Dlala i-Xiangqi nekhompyutha emazingeni angu-10 noma ku-inthanethi: mema umngane ngesixhumanisi noma udlale nomuntu omusha. Imithetho ephelele: umlenze wehhashi, iso lendlovu, ukweqa kwenganono nojenene abangavunyelwe ukubonana.

go-game.name: I-Go
go-game.desc: Dlala i-Go nekhompyutha emazingeni angu-10 noma ku-inthanethi emabhodini angu-9x9, 13x13 no-19x19 nomngane noma imbangi entsha. Ukubala okuzenzakalelayo ekugcineni.

memory-shapes.name: Inkumbulo yesimo nombala
memory-shapes.desc: Amathayili anezimo nemibala aboniswa imizuzwana emi-5, bese efihlwa; khumbula bese ukhetha ithayili efanele, amazinga ayi-10 kusuka kokulula kuya kokunzima.

web-desktop.name: Ideskithophu ye-inthanethi
web-desktop.desc: Ideskithophu yekhompyutha esipheqululini sakho: umphathi wamafayela, Notepad, isibukeli sezithombe ne-PDF, isibali, ikhalenda nodoti. Amafayela alondolozwa kuGoogle Drive yakho.

co-up.name: I-Xiangqi efihliwe (Cờ úp)
co-up.desc: Dlala i-Xiangqi efihliwe yaseVietnam: izingcezu ziqala zibheke phansi futhi ziphendulwa ngemuva kokunyakaza kokuqala. Nekhompyutha emazingeni angu-10 noma ku-inthanethi nabangane nezimbangi ezintsha.

bg-remove.drop.title: Khetha isithombe noma usihudulele lapha
bg-remove.drop.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP. Kuhle kakhulu ezithombeni zemikhiqizo ezingemuva elimhlophe noma lombala owodwa. Izithombe zicutshungulwa kudivayisi yakho.
bg-remove.tol.label: Ukuzwela
bg-remove.contiguous: Susa kuphela ingemuva elixhunywe emaphethelweni (kugcina imininingwane yombala ofanayo ngaphakathi kwento)
bg-remove.note.autobg: Umbala wengemuva utholakala emaphethelweni. Uma ungalungile, chofoza ingxenye yengemuva esithombeni sokuqala ukuze ukhethe futhi.
bg-remove.feather.label: Thambisa imiphetho
bg-remove.bgcolor.label: Umbala omusha wengemuva
bg-remove.canvas.title: Chofoza ingxenye yengemuva ukuze ukhethe umbala wayo
bg-remove.ai.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP. Izithombe eziningi kanyekanye, ngasinye singaphansi kwe-40 MB. Ungabuye unamathisele nge-Ctrl+V.
bg-remove.ai.mGeneral: Noma yini (imikhiqizo, izilwane ezifuywayo, izinto, abantu)
bg-remove.ai.mGeneralD: okunembe kakhulu, kulanda imodeli ecishe ibe ngu-200 MB okokuqala
bg-remove.ai.mPortraitD: okusheshayo, imodeli elula ecishe ibe ngu-25 MB, ilungele izithombe zikamazisi nezephrofayela
bg-remove.ai.note: I-AI isebenza kudivayisi yakho (isebenzisa ikhadi lemidwebo uma isiphequluli sisekela i-WebGPU); izithombe azithunyelwa neze ndawo. Imodeli ilandwa okokuqala kuphela futhi igcinwa kunqolobane yesiphequluli. Kumakhompyutha noma izingcingo ezindala, ukucubungula isithombe esisodwa kungathatha amasekhondi angu-10–60. Engemuva elimhlophe elilula, ithuluzi Lokususa Ingemuva Lesithombe liyashesha.
bg-remove.ai.err: Akukwazanga ukuqala i-AI kulesi siphequluli. Zama i-Chrome noma i-Edge yakamuva.

attendance.add.label: Engeza umfundi
attendance.add.ph: Thayipha igama bese ucindezela u-Enter (uma unamathisela amaningi, elilodwa emugqeni ngamunye)
attendance.date.label: Usuku lokuba khona
attendance.note: Chofoza iseli lesimo ukuze ushintshe: Ukhona → Akekho → Wephuzile → Unemvume. Amakholomu esifinyezo abala wonke umlando. Ngena nge-Google ukuze ugcine ku-Google Sheets.
attendance.th.name: Igama
attendance.empty: Abekho abafundi okwamanje. Engeza amagama ebhokisini elingenhla (ungananamathisela imigqa eminingi).

barcode.h.label: Ubude bomugqa

barcode.hint.EAN13: Faka izinombolo ezingu-12; inombolo yokuhlola yengezwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. I-barcode ejwayelekile yokuthengisa (isebenza njenge-EAN-13 ene-0 ngaphambili emikhiqizweni ye-UPC-A yase-US naseCanada).
barcode.hint.EAN8: Faka izinombolo ezingu-7; inombolo yokuhlola yengezwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Eyemikhiqizo emincane.
barcode.hint.UPCA: Faka izinombolo ezingu-11; inombolo yokuhlola yengezwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Ivamile emikhiqizweni yaseMelika.

bmi-bmr.actlvl.veryActive.hint: Umsebenzi onzima womzimba noma ukuzivocavoca kabili ngosuku.
bmi-bmr.note: I-BMI isebenzisa imingcele yase-Asia (efanele abantu baseVietnam): okujwayelekile 18,5–22,9. I-BMR isekelwe kwisibalo se-Mifflin–St Jeor; i-TDEE iyisamba samandla asetshenziswa nsuku zonke. Izinombolo ezolwazi kuphela futhi azithathi indawo yeseluleko sikadokotela noma sochwepheshe wokudla.
bmi-bmr.prompt: Faka iminyaka, ubude nesisindo esifanele ukuze ubone imiphumela.

calo-burn.note: Kulinganiswe ngamanani e-MET omhlaba (ukulingana kwe-metabolic): ama-khalori = MET × 3,5 × isisindo (kg) ÷ 200 × imizuzu. Imiphumela ingeyolwazi futhi incike kumandla nokuzilungiselela komuntu.

rsa-keys.pubPh: Chofoza "Dala ipheya yokhiye entsha" noma unamathisele ukhiye womphakathi ku-PEM (-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----) lapha, bese uchofoza "Sebenzisa ipheya yokhiye enamathiselwe".
rsa-keys.privPh: Ukhiye oyimfihlo ku-PEM (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----). Lo khiye uyadingeka ukuze uvule.
rsa-keys.status.none: Dala noma unamathisele ipheya yokhiye ngenhla. Ukhiye womphakathi ukuvumela ukubethela; ukhiye oyimfihlo ukuvumela ukuvula.
rsa-keys.plainPh: Thayipha umbhalo lapha; umugqa obethelwe uvela ngakwesokudla.
rsa-keys.cipherPh: Noma namathisela umugqa obethelwe lapha ukuze uwuvulele umbhalo.
rsa-keys.note: Konke kusebenza kusiphequluli sakho nge-Web Crypto futhi akuthunyelwa ndawo. Ngoba i-RSA ingabethela ngqo idatha emfushane kakhulu kuphela, ithuluzi lisebenzisa ukubethela okuxubile: lidala ukhiye we-AES ongahleliwe ukuze libethele umbhalo, bese ligoqa lowo khiye we-AES nge-RSA — ngakho umbhalo wanoma yibuphi ubude ungabethelwa. Umamukeli udinga ukhiye oyimfihlo ofanayo ukuze avule. Ukhiye womphakathi (SPKI) ungabelwana; ukhiye oyimfihlo (PKCS#8) kufanele ugcinwe uyimfihlo.
rsa-keys.status.ready: Kulungile: thayipha umbhalo ozowubethela, noma unamathisele umugqa obethelwe ukuze uwuvule.
rsa-keys.status.pubOnly: Ukhiye womphakathi ukhona: ungabethela. Akukho khiye oyimfihlo, ngakho awukakwazi ukuvula.
rsa-keys.status.privOnly: Ukhiye oyimfihlo ukhona: ungavula. Akukho khiye womphakathi, ngakho awukakwazi ukubethela.
rsa-keys.err.genHint: Isiphequluli kufanele sisekele i-Web Crypto (sebenzisa i-Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari yakamuva).
rsa-keys.err.pastePem: Namathisela ukhiye womphakathi noma oyimfihlo ku-PEM ebhokisini elingenhla.
rsa-keys.err.pubRead: Ukhiye womphakathi awufundekanga. Udinga ifomethi efanele ye-PEM yomphakathi (-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----, SPKI).
rsa-keys.err.privRead: Ukhiye oyimfihlo awufundekanga. Udinga ifomethi efanele ye-PEM eyimfihlo (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----, PKCS#8).
rsa-keys.status.noPub: Akukho khiye womphakathi, ngakho akukwazi ukubethela. Dala noma unamathisele ukhiye womphakathi.
rsa-keys.status.noPriv: Akukho khiye oyimfihlo, ngakho akukwazi ukuvula. Namathisela ukhiye oyimfihlo ofanayo.
rsa-keys.status.badFormat: Umugqa obethelwe awukho efomethini yaleli thuluzi.
rsa-keys.status.decErr: Akukwazanga ukuvula: ukhiye oyimfihlo awulungile, noma umugqa obethelwe ushintshiwe noma unqunyiwe.

Uphuthu nenyama ukudla okuthandwa kakhulu kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Afrika. NgeSonto ngalinye imindeni eminingi ihlangana etafuleni ukuze idle uphuthu nenyama eshisayo.

Ukuze wenze uphuthu nenyama okumnandi, udinga impuphu yombila, amanzi, usawoti nenyama yenkomo ephekwe kahle. Uphuthu luphekwa kancane ebhodweni cishe imizuzu engamashumi amabili.

Izivakashi zingabona izilwane zasendle eHluhluwe, zivakashele isigodlo saseNongoma noma zihambe ezitaladini eziphithizelayo zaseMgungundlovu. pdf-compress.noImgs: Azikho izithombe ze-JPEG ezizocindezelwa; isakhiwo sefayela sithuthukisiwe.
pdf-compress.notSmaller: Ifayela elicindezelwe alilona elincane kunelokuqala. Khetha izinga eliqinile, noma leli fayela selivele lithuthukisiwe.

pdf-to-word.dropTitle: Khetha ifayela le-PDF noma ulihudulele lapha
pdf-to-word.dropHint: Kufika ku-100 MB, amakhasi angu-300. Ifayela licutshungulwa kudivayisi yakho.
pdf-to-word.mTextD: izigaba nezihloko ongazihlela; izakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi (amathebula, amakholomu) zingase zishintshe
pdf-to-word.mImageD: ikhasi ngalinye liba yisithombe ku-Word, liyafana nelokuqala kodwa alihleleki
pdf-to-word.mBothD: izithombe zamakhasi kanye nombhalo ngaphansi kwazo wokukopisha
pdf-to-word.scanNote: Ama-PDF askeniwe (izithombe zamakhasi) awanawo umbhalo wangempela; sebenzisa ithuluzi Lombhalo Osuka Esithombeni (OCR) ekhasini ngalinye, noma ukhethe "Gcina isakhiwo sekhasi".
pdf-to-word.noText: Akukho mbhalo otholakele kuleli fayela (kungenzeka liyisithombe esiskeniwe). Khetha "Gcina isakhiwo sekhasi" noma usebenzise ithuluzi le-OCR.

word-to-pdf.dropTitle: Khetha ifayela le-Word (.docx) noma ulihudulele lapha
word-to-pdf.dropHint: Kufika ku-50 MB. Ifayela lifundwa kudivayisi yakho, alilayishwa neze.
word-to-pdf.note: "Landa i-PDF" yakha i-PDF khona manjalo (ikhasi ngalinye liyisithombe sekhwalithi ephezulu). "Phrinta / Gcina i-PDF enombhalo ocacile" ivula iwindi lokuphrinta: khetha iphrinta ethi "Save as PDF" ukuze uthole i-PDF enombhalo okhethekayo nosesheka. Izakhiwo eziyinkimbinkimbi (izihloko zekhasi, izinyawo, amabhokisi ombhalo, amashadi) zingahluka kokwokuqala.
word-to-pdf.oldDoc: Amafayela amadala e-.doc (Word 97-2003) awakasekelwa. Livule ku-Word, ligcine njenge-.docx, bese uzama futhi.
word-to-pdf.err: Akukwazanga ukwakha i-PDF. Zama inkinobho ethi Phrinta / Gcina i-PDF.
word-to-pdf.printTip: Khetha iphrinta ethi "Save as PDF" ukuze ugcine ifayela.

pdf-sign.dropTitle: Khetha i-PDF ozoyisayina noma uyihudulele lapha
pdf-sign.dropHint: Kufika ku-100 MB. Ifayela alilayishwa neze.
pdf-sign.tip: Khetha isiginesha, bese uchofoza ekhasini ukuze uyibeke. Hudula ukuze unyakazise, hudula isikwele esisekhoneni elingezansi ukuze ushintshe usayizi, cindezela u-× noma u-Delete ukuze ususe. Le siginesha yesithombe ilungele amaphepha ansuku zonke; ayithathi indawo yesiginesha yedijithali lapho idingwa umthetho.
pdf-sign.upHint: Isithombe sesiginesha yakho ephepheni elimhlophe (JPG, PNG)
pdf-sign.emptySig: Ayikho isiginesha okwamanje. Yidwebe, thayipha igama lakho noma ulayishe isithombe.

pdf-edit.dropTitle: Khetha ifayela le-PDF noma ulihudulele lapha
pdf-edit.dropHint: Kufika ku-100 MB. Ifayela alilayishwa neze.
pdf-edit.flatten: Khiya ifomu ngemva kokugcwalisa (alikwazi ukuphinda lihlelwe)
pdf-edit.tip: Khetha ithuluzi, bese uchofoza ekhasini ukuze ulibeke. Chofoza umbhalo ukuze uwuhlele, hudula ukuze unyakazise, hudula isikwele esisekhoneni elingezansi ukuze ushintshe usayizi, cindezela u-Delete ukuze ususe. Qaphela: "Ibhokisi elimnyama/Ukumboza ngokumhlophe" kumboza okuqukethwe ngokubonakalayo kuphela; umbhalo wokuqala ongaphansi uhlala efayeleni. Ukuze ususe ngempela ulwazi oluzwelayo, sebenzisa futhi i-Cindezela i-PDF ezingeni Eliphezulu kakhulu (iguqula amakhasi abe izithombe).
pdf-edit.unicodeLocked: Izinkambu ezinombhalo onezimpawu noma ongewona owesiLatini zibhalwe ngqo ekhasini (lezo zinkambu azisakwazi ukuhlelwa).

image-ocr.dropTitle: Khetha izithombe noma i-PDF eskeniwe, noma uzihudulele lapha
image-ocr.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, PDF. Ungabuye unamathisele isithombe-skrini nge-Ctrl+V.
image-ocr.enhance: Cacisa isithombe ngaphambi kokufunda (izithombe ezifiphele, umbhalo omncane)
image-ocr.note: Ukubona kusebenza kusiphequluli sakho; okokuqala kulanda injini nedatha yolimi (cishe u-5–20 MB ngolimi ngalunye), izikhathi ezilandelayo zishesha kakhulu. Izithombe ezicacile ezinombhalo ophrintiwe engemuva elikhanyayo zisebenza kahle kakhulu; ukubhala ngesandla kunzima ukukubona.
image-ocr.max3: Khetha izilimi ezi-3 kuphela ukuze ukubona kushesha futhi kunembe.
image-ocr.pdfLimit: Kungezwe amakhasi angu-50 okuqala kuphela e-PDF.
image-ocr.noText: Akukho mbhalo otholakele. Zama isithombe esicacile kakhulu, ulimi olufanele, noma uvule ukucacisa.
image-ocr.errNet: Akukwazanga ukulanda injini yokubona noma idatha yolimi. Hlola uxhumano lwakho lwe-inthanethi bese uzama futhi.

heic-jpg.dropTitle: Khetha izithombe ze-HEIC noma uzihudulele lapha
heic-jpg.dropHint: Izithombe ze-.heic / .heif ezivela ku-iPhone noma i-iPad. Eziningi kanyekanye, ngasinye singaphansi kwe-50 MB.
heic-jpg.note: Izithombe ziguqulwa kudivayisi yakho. Okokuqala, kulandwa isiqaqi se-HEIC (cishe u-1.5 MB). Kuma-Live Photos kugcinwa uhlaka oluyinhloko kuphela. Idatha yendawo ye-GPS evela kokwokuqala ayidluliswa.
heic-jpg.notHeic: akusona isithombe se-HEIC. Ezithombeni ezijwayelekile ze-JPG/PNG sebenzisa ithuluzi Lokuguqula Ifomethi Yesithombe.
heic-jpg.errNet: Akukwazanga ukulanda isiqaqi. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
heic-jpg.errDecode: Akukwazanga ukufunda lesi sithombe (ifayela elonakele noma uhlobo lwe-HEIC olungasekelwa).

image-upscale.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP. Izithombe ezincane, ezifiphele noma ezindala zizuza kakhulu.
image-upscale.mX4c: kususa amabala e-JPEG, ezithombeni ezigcinwe ku-inthanethi
image-upscale.note: I-AI isebenza kudivayisi yakho; izithombe azithunyelwa neze ndawo. Okokuqala kulandwa imodeli engu-5–20 MB. Izithombe zicutshungulwa ngezingcezu ezincane, ngakho ezinkulu zingathatha imizuzu embalwa; kunconywa i-Chrome noma i-Edge yakamuva (nge-WebGPU kushesha kakhulu).
image-upscale.err: Akukwazanga ukuqala i-AI kulesi siphequluli. Zama i-Chrome noma i-Edge yakamuva.

video-compress.dropHint: MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI. Kungcono ngaphansi kwe-300 MB (okuphezulu kakhulu 500 MB).
video-compress.note: Ividiyo icindezelwa kusiphequluli sakho nge-ffmpeg futhi ayilayishwa neze. Okokuqala, kulandwa isicubunguli (cishe u-31 MB). Ukucindezela kusebenzisa i-CPU, ngakho kuhamba kancane kunezinhlelo zekhompyutha: ividiyo yomzuzu owodwa ngokuvamile ithatha imizuzu engu-1–5. Ungayivali le thebhu kuze kuqedwe.
video-compress.tooBig: Ividiyo inkulu kune-500 MB — lokho kungaphezu kwalokho isiphequluli esingakucubungula. Qala uyisike.
video-compress.errCode: I-ffmpeg ayikwazanga ukucubungula le vidiyo (ifomethi engajwayelekile noma ifayela elonakele).
video-compress.notSmaller: Ividiyo ecindezelwe ayincane (eyokuqala isivele icindezelwe kahle). Khetha Okuqinile noma ukucaca okuphansi.

video-to-mp3.dropHint: MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, FLV… Kufika ku-1 GB.
video-to-mp3.fade: Ukukhula nokuncipha kancane (amasekhondi ama-2), kuhle kumaringithoni
video-to-mp3.note: Kucutshungulwa kusiphequluli sakho nge-ffmpeg; ividiyo ayilayishwa neze. Okokuqala kulandwa isicubunguli (cishe u-31 MB). Khipha umsindo kuphela kumavidiyo onelungelo lokuwasebenzisa.
video-to-mp3.tooBig: Ifayela likhulu kune-1 GB — lokho kungaphezu kwalokho isiphequluli esingakucubungula.
video-to-mp3.badTime: Isikhathi asivumelekile. Sebenzisa imizuzu:amasekhondi, isib. 1:30; ukuphela kufanele kube ngemva kokuqala.
video-to-mp3.noAudio: Akukwazanga ukukhipha umsindo. Kungenzeka ividiyo ayinawo umsindo noma ifomethi ayisekelwa.

web-desktop.textTooBig: Leli fayela likhulu kuno-5 MB, likhulu kakhulu kuNotepad. Lilande bese ulivula ku-app esekhompyutheni yakho.
web-desktop.imgFail: Lesi sithombe asikwazi ukuboniswa. Silande bese usivula kwenye i-app.
